_comment: Route B F6: the Spire run mag (SpireMag.hh). Read at every 'Z' request; a missing or broken file answers every 'Z' with no mag. Enabled false is the data-only kill switch: every 'Z' answers 0, no restart needed. Steps: step 0 = the kit, step n = after the n-th boss; stats are levels (DEF/POW/DEX/MIND), the data1 words are levels x 100. Id is data1[1] (decimal), chosen along Sega's evolution rules (Items.cc player_feed_mag) so each step is a Sega mag of that level. Per stat the server keeps max(step, start floor, the run mag as last mirrored), so feeding is never lost. StartFloors: from that start_level bonus on, the mag starts at least at Sega's challenge template mag (PlayerSubordinates.cc v3 templates: HU Varuna L13 and L22, RA Kalki L12 and L20, FO Vritra L13 and L22). BossRooms: the boss rooms k (one room counter: Episode 1 k4-k15, Episode 2 k18-k27; ROUTEB-F6-PROTOCOL.md); after the last step a boss adds nothing (Ep2 steps are data-only later); a run that first asks in room k starts at the number of boss rooms before k (practice runs).

HU._what: Fang (attack). Mag 0, Varuna 1, Rudra 14, Varaha 5, Kama 6. Step 4 is not Sega's Sato L70 (POW 30): that would lower POW.

RA._what: Fang (attack). Mag 0, Kalki 13, Surya 3, Kama 6, Madhu 38.

FO._what: Mind (techs): the HU line with POW and MIND swapped. Mag 0, Vritra 25, Namuci 26, Kabanda 30, Naga 28.
